svg.title: A-02 · ReBo: A reports bot for any SQL database that learns from the people who use it. Ask in plain words; it writes one read-only query, runs it, and says how it read the question. Five independent walls stand between a question and a write, from a SELECT-only user to a syntax-tree guard. Repeat questions rerun with no model call; 44 of 48 matching numbers on a test company, at about two cents a question. Stack: Python 3.13, Pydantic AI, sqlglot, SQLAlchemy, FastAPI, MCP, pgvector, React 19, Phoenix.
